notes.title: Balance patch 0.7.10
notes.content: [p][b]Game has been updated to version 0.7.10.[/b][/p][p][b]Changelog:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Damage of the MP-133 reduced by 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to choose a starting bonus (armor, backpack, or weapon) on Easy and Medium difficulties (only when playing solo).[/p][/*][*][p]Bot gear upgrade speed and difficulty increase are now tied to player progression (previously depended on match time).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where character actions would trigger while typing in chat.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved lighting from muzzle flashes and explosions.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted bot respawns to avoid large clusters.[/p][/*][*][p]Equipment upgrades now have a cooldown (previously could be reused only after death).[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the explosion radius of propane.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an awkward ledge in the center of the Outskirts map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed one of the errors that could cause a crash at the end of a match.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where previously searched containers didn’t give experience for searching after loot was updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Bots now notice the player more slowly if they are outside their line of sight.[/p][/*][*][p]Bots can now miss with a small chance, which depends on difficulty.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.7.9
notes.content: [p][b]The game has been updated to version 0.7.9.[/b][/p][p][b]List of changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a tutorial level explaining the main mechanics and principles of the game[/p][/*][*][p]Improved spawning of bots in PvE mode: now the limit of bots on the map is more balanced, bots do not spawn close to the player[/p][/*][*][p]Added a PB pistol, has similar characteristics to the PM. Can be found on bots[/p][/*][*][p]Added a sawed-off shotgun MP-27, has similar characteristics to the original. Can be found on bots[/p][/*][*][p]Added AS "Val", has similar characteristics to the VSS "Vintorez". Can be found on bots[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the displayed object for interaction/loot does not match what is actually used[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where a player who left the match was still shown in the statistics in PvP[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where bots could not break a window[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the rate of fire for AK-74 "Zenit"[/p][/*][*][p]Added an exclusion from the match for inactivity (3 minutes)[/p][/*][*][p]Added the option "Automatic descent down the stairs" in the settings, manual descent is carried out by the S key[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the spawn of weapons in containers (removed high-level weapons from loot in the early game)[/p][/*][*][p]Equipping purchased equipment during life no longer removes / replaces items that are better than purchased[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the volume of the voice chat[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to zoom in / out the camera in spectator mode[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the spawn of the laptop: now it has two random points spawn[/p][/*][*][p]Hack laptop removed from task list[/p][/*][*][p]Removed achievement limit[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced required points in pvp[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch with fixes 0.7.8
notes.content: [p]The game has been updated to version [b]0.7.8[/b].[/p][p][b]Changelog:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reworked bot spawn balance. Bot spawn rate now adapts to player performance (with an element of randomness).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug in PvP where victory was counted by total kills instead of points.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the laptop didn’t appear in PvE.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where a PvP match wouldn’t end with only one player left in the lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when pressing the “Leave Match” button.[/p][/*][*][p]Newly unlocked customization items are now automatically equipped.[/p][/*][*][p]Hack laptop task appears only on difficulty "Medium" or higher[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch with fixes 0.7.7
notes.content:
[b]Game updated to version 0.7.7.
List of changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] The lobby list interface has been changed to show more useful information (lobby version, match timer, and points)
[*] Small rebalance for "Easy" and "Medium" difficulties
[*] Now access to "Medium" difficulty unlocks at level 4
[*] P90 damage increased by 1
[*] Fixed a bug where it was still possible to shoot in some cases after the match ended
[*] Added a sound notification when other players join the lobby
[*] Fixed a bug where bots with single-shot weapons would stop shooting
[*] Fixed a bug where a player's marker would remain after they disconnected
[*] Slightly slowed down the gear upgrade for bots
[*] Changed the bot spawn algorithm for better balance
[/list]

notes.title: Patch with fixes 0.7.6
notes.content: [p][b]Game has been updated to version 0.7.6.[/b][/p][p][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The formula for calculating boss health has been changed. It now depends only on the number of players.[/p][/*][*][p]A weapon spawn table has been added for bots, and the chances of different weapons appearing have been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]The speed of gear upgrades for bots has been slightly slowed down on different difficulties.[/p][/*][*][p]The penalty for deaths at the end of a match has been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]The number of required kills per match has been reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]"Hard" and "Desperate" difficulties are now only available at a certain account level.[/p][/*][*][p]The ability to create friends-only or private lobbies has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where accuracy would increase instead of decrease when walking with shotguns and submachine guns.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the game interface would be hidden when the chat was opened.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.6.2 Hotfix is out!
notes.content:
A small technical update has been released that fixes most of the serious bugs.

[b]Here is the list of changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed synchronization of corpses
[*] Fixed desync associated with player inventory and AI
[*] Fixed a bug where AI opponents could not be looted
[*] Fixed bugs when players displayed incorrect equipment
[*] AI now fire bursts, slightly increased the delay between shots with a single weapon (SKS, MP-133)
[*] Minor AI logic tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: 0.6.1 Update is out!
notes.content:
[b]-Added text chat during the match[/b]
[b]-Fixed bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Low level players encountered difficult opponents (PvE)
[*] Fixed a bug where things obtained in battle did not disappear after death
[*] Fixed a bug where the time before the start of the match was not displayed in the lobby
[/list]
[b]-Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Corrected loot table
[*] The "Collect loot" button is now highlighted if there are items that need to be retrieved
[*]  Unavailable items from the merchant are now sorted by required level
[/list]

[i]P.S. The problem of out-of-sync weapons and equipment is also known, it is in the process of debugging and solving[/i]
